findings.evidence: workflow gate/run jobs require workflow_dispatch/main and checkout github.sha. CLI requires HEAD==GITHUB_SHA, fixed repository/workflow_ref, and git-show reads exact commit bytes; a rolling current main is not trusted in place of that source. Final merger re-reads main and rejects changed BASE.

verifyExecutionRun reads actual GitHub REST run and binds id/attempt/workflow_id/path/event/repositories/main/source/status before and again after collection. Native candidate signatures still require cryptographic quorum. No new OIDC/CA requirement is claimed or needed to replace that existing design.

All main workflow_dispatch executions share one queue and the existing global stop. PR verification has a different event/ref queue; adding request IDs to production concurrency would weaken serialization. The workflow explicitly rejects non-main dispatch.

request is passed only as env data. CLI JSON.parse uses validateCollectionRequest exact six-field schema; no eval/exec or user filename interpolation exists. Git input is bounded40hex, and modes/paths/API surfaces are fixed.

readCandidateAdmission resolves fixed evidence ref then verifies immutable content at commit SHA with base64/size/git-blob SHA1 and subject/check binding. A local fetch or git-commit signature is not a substitute for the required role Ed25519 signatures.

Gate report now includes source, candidate, input digest, run and attempt; execution already includes run/attempt. Artifact names bind run+attempt with v4 create behavior. Docs retain30-day availability limitation. Authoritative action receipts stay on isolated claim refs, and artifacts are not signer identity or stage votes.

Final CLI writes an explicit GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY status, blockers and no-verified-automatic-merge warning. Disabled gate exits successfully as a valid observation; the write job remains skipped. No CI success is counted as actual merge.

limitations: Controller dispositions are not independent acceptance or activation approval.
Claude must read complete new executor/CLI/workflow at current exact head.
No native attestation producer is implemented; nonce challenge keys cannot count as model generation.
The separate trusted L0 BASE check is not green on this candidate; do not describe all checks as passing.
